beats.reason: Brief explicitly earlier-week cape from arrival blanket and James independence/support exchange; source origin Pilot.
Brief practical cooperation/training arrangement after altered rescue aftermath; actual tests occur in Episode 2.
DEO missile tests and Winn harbor alert; Kara shares destination with Alex.
Ordinary call/private complete costume change precede masked rescue; hull spill prevented through teamwork. Public footage does not identify civilian Adrian.
Lord criticizes actual fire mistake; Cat seeks interview and masked rescuer identity but does not identify her employee.
Plastino guard killed/stinger evidence, Kara childhood Alura memory and species identification.
Alex discloses emitters and obtains agreement after Chapter 4 warning promise; low-powered sparring teaches Kara technique.
Cat encourages measured help; Winn/James learn each other knows, assist smaller rescues; James cannot promise Cat will never recognize Kara.
Astra cannot identify masked helper. Coerces Hellgrammite to bring an agent to temporary rendezvous and warns against confronting both flyers; no Kael-triggered evacuation.
DDT biology motivates bait; informed DEO uses closed approaches, Kara cargo cover and pre-unsealed masked Adrian.
Immediate capture prevents Alex abduction. Private voice/direct confirmation reveals only Kael identity to familiar prisoner; he supplies rendezvous lead.
Adrian checks lead immediately, disarms guards, identifies himself privately, stops Astra withdrawal. Kara confronts her alive; early capture replaces source duel/escape.
Interactive Alura and private reader-side Hank clue retained after Adrian reseals/leaves. No AI answers assumed.
No knife/doctor/escape. Astra learns of kryptonite during guarded DEO custody instead; no immunity of Adrian tested.
Kara chooses interview and does not give masked helper’s identity. Cat transported to nonspecific secluded place; main interview later.

original_scene_amendments.effect: Anonymous public rescue; no Cat/Astra TV identification; private recognition, immediate lead pursuit and early Astra capture instead of restoring superseded escape/remote endpoint.
